answer: Nadir job check: each epoch the clerk picks the lowest-paid job of every alias, the nadir job, and reads it word for word against the requester's posted brief. An alias whose nadir job answers a different brief than the one posted loses the pay for that job and sits out new jobs for 30 days. Each check lands as one plume line on the jade board, a public list that shows 30 days of passes and fails for every alias. An alias that fails twice in 30 days has its last 14 days of pay held pending review.
